All tests pass. Implementation complete.

**What was added:**
- `src/cache.ts` — SHA-256 hashing, `.ssg-cache.json` manifest load/save, in-memory frontmatter cache (`parseFrontmatterCached`).
- `src/build.ts` — incremental build logic: per-file source hashes + a combined templates-directory hash determine whether a page is rebuilt or skipped; deleted pages have stale output removed; `BuildResult` now carries `stats` (`pagesBuilt`, `pagesSkipped`, `timeSavedMs`).
- `src/ssg.ts` — `BuildOptions` gained `incremental`/`clean`.
- `src/cli.ts` — `--incremental`/`--clean` flags parsed and threaded through; build summary now reports built/skipped/saved.
- `test/incremental.test.ts` — 12 jest tests covering manifest creation, full skip, changed-source rebuild, template-change rebuild, `--clean`, missing-cache fallback, non-incremental behavior, stale-file cleanup, new-page builds, and time-saved reporting.

Existing behavior (plugins, non-incremental builds, dev server) is unchanged — all prior 37 tests still pass.
